segments.an6.13:1.4: ‘mettā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā;
segments.an6.13:1.5: atha ca pana me byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an6.13:1.6: So ‘mā hevan’ tissa vacanīyo – ‘māyasmā, evaṃ avaca; mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
segments.an6.13:1.7: Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya;
segments.an6.13:1.8: atha ca panassa byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati [ṭhassatīti (sabbattha) dī. ni.3.326 passitabbaṃ], netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an6.13:2.2: ‘karuṇā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā;
segments.an6.13:2.3: atha ca pana me vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an6.13:2.4: So ‘mā hevan’ tissa vacanīyo – ‘māyasmā, evaṃ avaca; mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
segments.an6.13:2.5: Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ karuṇāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya;
segments.an6.13:2.6: atha ca panassa vihesā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an6.13:3.2: ‘muditā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā;
segments.an6.13:3.3: atha ca pana me arati cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an6.13:3.4: So ‘mā hevan’ tissa vacanīyo – ‘māyasmā, evaṃ avaca; mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
segments.an6.13:3.5: Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ muditāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya;
segments.an6.13:3.6: atha ca panassa arati cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an6.13:4.2: ‘upekkhā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā;
segments.an6.13:4.3: atha ca pana me rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an6.13:4.4: So ‘mā hevan’ tissa vacanīyo – ‘māyasmā, evaṃ avaca; mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
segments.an6.13:4.5: Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya;
segments.an6.13:4.6: atha ca panassa rāgo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an6.13:5.2: ‘animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā;
segments.an6.13:5.3: atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī’ti.
segments.an6.13:5.4: So ‘mā hevan’ tissa vacanīyo – ‘māyasmā, evaṃ avaca; mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
segments.an6.13:5.5: Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ animittāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya;
segments.an6.13:5.6: atha ca panassa nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ bhavissati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an6.13:6.2: ‘asmīti kho me vigataṃ [vigate (syā.)], ayamahamasmīti ca [ayaṃ cakāro dī. ni.3.326 natthi] na samanupassāmi;
segments.an6.13:6.3: atha ca pana me vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī’ti.
segments.an6.13:6.4: So ‘mā hevan’ tissa vacanīyo – ‘māyasmā, evaṃ avaca; mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
segments.an6.13:6.5: Aṭṭhānametaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ asmīti vigate ayamahamasmīti ca na samanupassato;
segments.an6.13:6.6: atha ca panassa vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallaṃ cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.an6.13:6.7: Nissaraṇañhetaṃ, āvuso, vicikicchākathaṃkathāsallassa yadidaṃ asmīti mānasamugghāto’ti.
segments.an6.13:7.1: Imā kho, bhikkhave, cha nissāraṇīyā dhātuyo”ti.

lines: Mettā hi kho me cetovimuttīti ettha paccanīkadhammehi vimuttattā tikacatukkajjhānikā mettāva mettācetovimutti nāma.
Mā hevantissa vacanīyoti yasmā abhūtabyākaraṇaṃ byākaroti, tasmā “mā evaṃ bhaṇī”ti vattabbo.
Yadidaṃ mettācetovimuttīti yā ayaṃ mettācetovimutti, idaṃ nissaraṇaṃ byāpādassa, byāpādato nissaṭāti attho.
Yo pana mettāya tikacatukkajjhānato vuṭṭhito saṅkhāre sammasitvā tatiyamaggaṃ patvā “puna byāpādo natthī”ti tatiyaphalena nibbānaṃ passati, tassa cittaṃ accantanissaraṇaṃ byāpādassa.
Sā hi rāganimittādīnañceva rūpanimittādīnañca niccanimittādīnañca abhāvā animittāti vuttā.
Ayamahamasmīti pañcasu khandhesu ayaṃ nāma ahaṃ asmīti.
Mā hevantissa vacanīyoti sace te paṭhamamaggavajjhā vicikicchā uppajjati, arahattabyākaraṇaṃ micchā hoti, tasmā “mā abhūtaṃ gaṇhī”ti vāretabbo.
Arahattamaggaphalavasena hi nibbāne diṭṭhe puna asmimāno natthīti arahattamaggo “asmīti mānasamugghāto”ti vutto.
Iti imasmiṃ sutte abhūtabyākaraṇaṃ nāma kathitaṃ.
Yuttayānasadisā katāti yathā yuttamājaññayānaṃ chekena sārathinā adhiṭṭhitaṃ yathāruci pavattati, evaṃ yathāruci pavattirahaṃ gahitā.
Vatthukatāti vā adhiṭṭhānaṭṭhena vatthu viya katā, sabbaso upakkilesavisodhanena iddhivisesatāya pavattiṭṭhānabhāvato suvisodhitaparissayavatthu viya katāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Abhūtabyākaraṇaṃ byākarotīti “mettā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā”tiādinā attani avijjamānaguṇābhibyāhāraṃ byāharati.
Puna byāpādo natthīti idāni mama byāpādo nāma sabbaso natthīti ñatvā.
Balavavipassanāti bhayatupaṭṭhāne ñāṇaṃ, ādīnavānupassane ñāṇaṃ muccitukamyatāñāṇaṃ, bhaṅgañāṇanti catunnaṃ ñāṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Yesaṃ nimittānaṃ abhāvena arahattaphalasamāpattiyā animittatā, taṃ dassetuṃ “sā hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha rāgassa nimittaṃ, rāgo eva vā nimittaṃ rāganimittaṃ.
Tayidaṃ nimittaṃ yasmā sabbena sabbaṃ arahattaphale natthi, tasmā vuttaṃ “sā hi … pe … animittā”ti.
Nimittaṃ anussarati anugacchati ārabbha pavattati sīlenāti nimittānusārī.
